description: Read-only digest of the calling seller's inbox: pending quote requests, orders at risk of missing their ship-by deadline, and orders with reported issues. Useful for a daily standup or cron-driven agent that decides which bulk action to run next.

limit.description: Max items to surface in each bucket.

window_hours.description: Look-ahead window for ship-by-date risk detection (default 24h).

name: seller_inbox_summarise
title: Summarise seller inbox
